title: Pseudorabies Virus Injection into Inguinal White Adipose Tissue
author: Clara Huesing
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baamiac6

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Workstation
steps.instruction: Set up the surgical environment and prepare necessary reagents and tools.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the glass bead sterilizer.
Turn on the two heating pads (stereotaxic platform and recovery area).
Place a non-sterile towel on the recovery heating pad and a sterile towel on the stereotaxic platform heating pad.
Place a sterile towel to the right of the stereotaxic platform with a rack containing three tubes: 'Novalsan', '70% Isopropanol', and 'Empty'.
Place multiple sterile cotton swabs into each 50mL tube.
Place an empty cage halfway on the recovery heating pad.
Fill one 3mL syringe completely with sterile saline and place it under the stereotaxic heating pad to warm.
Fill 3mL syringes with sterile saline (~1.5ml for a 25g mouse) and place under the recovery heating pad to warm.
Fill 0.5ml syringes with 0.1ml Bupivacaine/lidocaine.
Place surgical tools, eye lubricant, wound clip applicators, spare wound clips, sterile gauze, and a timer on the sterile towel to the right of the stereotaxic platform.

steps.title: Set Up Anesthesia
steps.instruction: Configure the anesthesia machine for induction and maintenance.

substeps.instruction: Open the O2 tank valve and set the O2 level to 1% on the anesthesia machine.
Set the isoflurane level to 5% for the induction box.

steps.title: Prepare Virus Syringe
steps.instruction: Prepare and verify the Hamilton syringe for PRV injection.

substeps.instruction: Place aluminum foil on a clean surface as the designated area to test and fill the syringe with PRV.
Place a rack with three tubes containing '70% Ethanol', 'dH2O', and 'Waste'.
Test the syringe flow by filling with dH2O and flushing several times; replace the syringe if flow is not steady.

steps.title: Induce Anesthesia and Secure Mouse
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse and secure it in the stereotaxic apparatus.

substeps.instruction: Record the mouse's body weight and ear tag number (if applicable).
Place the mouse into the induction chamber with isoflurane set to 5%.

Once unconscious, adjust isoflurane to 1.8% (adjust based on breathing), open the stereotaxic valve, close the induction box valve, and place the mouse in the stereotaxic nose cone, aligning incisors into the hole with a cotton swab.
Secure the nose cone by tightening the top screw and verify security by gently tugging the base of the tail.
Check anesthetic depth by testing the withdrawal reflex of a hind limb.

steps.title: Pre-Surgical Preparation
steps.instruction: Administer medication and prepare the surgical site.

substeps.instruction: Spray the interscapular region with 70% ethanol and inject carprofen (10ul-20ul/gram body weight) subcutaneously.
Place a kimwipe underneath the mouse, shave the right dorsolumbar region, and remove all hair.
Disinfect the shaved area by performing three alternating scrubs of isopropanol and Novalsan using cotton swabs.

steps.title: Surgical Exposure of iWAT
steps.instruction: Perform the incision to access the inguinal white adipose tissue (iWAT) depot.

substeps.instruction: Pull the skin up at the midline of the back, parallel to the hip, with forceps and make a transverse cut extending the length of the dorsolumbar portion of the iWAT fat pad.
Use a sterile cotton swab to remove connective tissue underneath the incision to spread it apart until the iWAT depot is fully accessible.
Apply sterile saline to sterile gauze and place it over the iWAT to keep the tissue moist.

steps.title: PRV Virus Injection
steps.instruction: Inject the PRV-152 virus into the iWAT pad.

substeps.instruction: Fill the syringe with PRV-152 virus and return to the surgery platform.
Remove the saline-soaked gauze from the iWAT.
Administer 10 injections of 200nl (10x200nl) into the right iWAT pad, holding the syringe parallel (not perpendicular) to the fat pad to avoid the peritoneal wall.
Hold the syringe in place for ~30 seconds after each injection to minimize backflow.
Slowly pull the syringe out while holding a sterile cotton swab on the injection site to dry any virus leakage.
Place a fresh, saline-soaked gauze on top of the iWAT.
Clean the syringe with 4-5 alternating flushes of 70% ethanol and dH2O, collecting liquid as biohazard waste.

steps.title: Wound Closure
steps.instruction: Close the incision and apply wound clips.

substeps.instruction: Remove the saline-soaked gauze from the iWAT.
Reposition the overlaying skin to its original location using a sterile cotton swab and teethed forceps.
Use teethed and tissue forceps to align both sides of the incision, ensuring the subcutaneous layer is not protruding past the external skin layer.
Administer wound clips ~25mm apart, starting from the side closest to the midline (usually 4-5 clips).
Tighten each wound clip with hemostats, ensuring they are not too tight to avoid irritation or poor circulation.

steps.title: Post-Surgical Recovery
steps.instruction: Administer local anesthesia and recover the mouse.

substeps.instruction: Inject 0.05mL of bupivacaine/lidocaine subcutaneously at both ends of the incision using teethed forceps to lift the skin.
Turn off isoflurane, loosen the nose cone, and remove the mouse's incisors from the mount using the wooden end of a cotton swab.
Scruff the mouse, turn it over, and inject ~1.5mL (for a 25g mouse) of warm saline intraperitoneally.
Place the mouse on its side on the warm side of the cage on the recovery heating mat.
Wet a chow pellet with water from the cage and place it on the floor for easy access.
Sterilize all surgical tools in the glass bead sterilizer for 15-20 seconds and change gloves.

steps.title: Post-Operative Care
steps.instruction: Monitor the mouse and provide follow-up care over 10 days.

substeps.instruction: Day 1 post-op: Administer carprofen subcutaneously (~10ul/g bw), record weight, and perform health check.
Day 2 post-op: Administer carprofen subcutaneously (~10ul/g bw), record weight, and perform health check.
Days 3–7 post-op: Record weight and perform health check.
Day 10 post-op: Remove wound clips and replace the PVC pipe in the cage.
Wipe loose fur off the mouse using a kimwipe.
